name: The pound and the cage
region: Foot of Chapel Lane, sick village

sensoryProfile.sight: A ring of drystone wall with a ewe inside; against the wall a little round house of fieldstone no bigger than a bread oven with a stone dome roof and a door of iron bars; a stone bench along the back wall, straw on the floor. Torchlight; Sylvanas's lamp.
sensoryProfile.sound: The iron door going open 'with a scream'; heels scraping on straw; torch hiss; a dog barking up the lane and giving up.
sensoryProfile.touch: Cold stone floor; the dead boy warm through his smock.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: The village's drunk-tank, used 'a hundred times for a drunk on a fair night'; now Tam's death.

establishedFacts.fact: Brask keeps the key (found by feel). The cage is at the bottom of Chapel Lane by the pound, apparently on the way to the granary.
Tam dies here of poison; Lyriel covers his face with a spare cloak; his body is left (Brask will see to it).

eventsHere.event: Tam is locked in; questioned; convulses and dies; Sylvanas finds the collar poison; Brask's 'Cover his face, somebody.'
